game.name: Dj Hero (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)(Demo)
game.desc: DJ Hero on Xbox 360 is a rhythm game that is played with a DJ turntable equipped with 3 keys that you have to press at the right time. But that's not all, there's also a crossfader that you have to move according to the keys you have to press, as well as an effects potentiometer. You also have the possibility to scratch with the turntable when you are asked to!
